args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west) failed health checks with an elevated error rate of 18%. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified in all regions: service now healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate reduced to ~0.2%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging (seq 2), suggesting the issue existed pre-production; v2.3.1 requires investigation before any re-deploy.

Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** all regions to **v2.3.0** — verified: service is now healthy with error rate down to ~0.2%.
